text:
Alyssa: quick check  thinking of moving the alert preview trigger inline beneath channel chips rather than the card footer so it stays visible when users toggle suppression. anyone see problems? :eyes:
Tom: fine with that. main constraint is not increasing row height in dense lists. propose compact = text link + icon, expanded = small secondary button.
Ravi: agree on compact link. copy nit: avoid the word 'telemetry' for most users. prefer 'Preview recent notifications' or 'Show recent alerts'. shorter variant could just be 'Preview'.
Marta: +1 on 'Preview recent notifications' for expanded, 'Preview' for compact with tooltip. also we should show a muted indicator in the preview header when suppression is applied so users don't think the system failed.
Alyssa: good call. accessibility notes?
A11y Bot: add aria-label="Preview recent notifications for selected channels" on the trigger, aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded state. When preview loads, update an aria-live="polite" region with "Preview loaded: X results". If suppressed channels reduce results include "Y channels suppressed" in the announcement.
Tom: keyboard order is key: channels -> suppression -> preview. keep suppression before preview so keyboard users can toggle and immediately preview. also ensure the preview trigger is reachable with a single tab and focus returns to it after close.
Ravi: performance/dev: lazy-load preview data on click for compact lists; cache last successful preview per rule for 30s and show a tiny cached badge in the flyout header when using cached data.
Marta: copy for suppressed case: in the preview header show "No recent alerts (suppressed)" and a context link "Show suppressed sends" that toggles suppression in place. link should be keyboard-focusable.
A11y Bot: color/accessibility: inline link must meet 4.5:1 contrast for body text. if we remain small use stronger token or increase size. focus outline must be visible (>=3:1 with background).
Alyssa: analytics: emit event preview_open with {"rule_id":"r_...","channels":[...],"suppressed":true/false,"variant":"compact|panel","cached":true/false,"result_count":int}. will add to spec.
Tom: I'll prototype compact link in storybook and add keyboard tests (tab order, focus restore, aria-live updates).
Ravi: I'll implement lazy-load + cache and the cached badge.
Marta: I'll update Figma with compact/expanded variants and copy changes, and add a checklist item to PRs for keyboard-only QA and contrast checks.
Alyssa: thanks team  I'll drop the mock and attach the PR checklist. :white_check_mark:
